title: API response times exceeding SLA
description: Our trading API calls are consistently taking 3-5 seconds to respond. SLA states under 200ms. This is causing real financial losses during high-volume trading windows. We need immediate resolution or we will need to evaluate alternatives.

title: HIPAA compliance audit finding - data residency concern
description: During our annual HIPAA audit, the auditors flagged that some patient data may be temporarily stored in non-compliant regions during the migration process you initiated last month. We need documentation proving data residency compliance within 5 business days or we face regulatory penalties.

title: Data migration causing duplicate records
description: The data migration that was supposed to improve our system has introduced duplicate patient records. We've found 47 duplicates so far. This is a patient safety issue.

title: Report export formatting broken after last update
description: Since the platform update 2 weeks ago, our monthly financial reports export with garbled formatting. This affects our board reporting timeline. Not urgent but annoying.

title: Request for bulk user import feature
description: We are onboarding 200 new students next semester and need a bulk import feature. Currently adding users one by one is too slow. This would be a great enhancement.

title: Fleet tracking GPS data intermittent gaps
description: We're seeing 5-10 minute gaps in GPS tracking data for about 15% of our fleet vehicles. Not critical yet but could become a compliance issue if it worsens.
